icp: People supervising AI teammates using their paired computer
buyerPain: A silent browser stream can leave a stale screen and controls presented as connected
revenueHypothesis: Honest connection status and safe recovery improve trust in paid computer workflows
objective: Expire silent browser observations and recover in watch-only mode without replaying actions
acceptanceCriteria: A 30-second heartbeat silence invalidates the current browser viewer and clears stale frame, control and queued input
Late timers or messages from replaced sessions and profiles cannot affect the current viewer
Recovery reuses existing bounded reconnect and remains watch-only without navigation or action replay
Focused regression tests, type checks and isolated runtime smoke verify the real Browser panel
Security and delivery gates reported without treating unavailable verification as a pass
rollback: Revert the scoped recovery commit; no data migration, live account change or production deployment
